title: Racing runs in the browser engine
author: Shockwave, Engine Lead
body: The browser build can now run a race, the same way it runs a tank match. A race starts from 1 to 4 racing builds checked by the same catalog as the build screen. Each frame the viewer gets every car's position, heading, speed, lap and place, and the track's shape once up front, so it can draw the Ring before the race.

The same seed and builds give the same race in the browser, in Rust and from Python, and racing replays recorded in Python now verify in the browser. A four-car race runs in about 16 ms. Everything the tank game already returns is unchanged.
next: Blitzwing's race viewer slice draws the track and cars from this API.
